mapper.insert: INSERT INTO public.tb_push_outbox (notification_id) VALUES (#{notificationId, jdbcType=BIGINT}) ON CONFLICT (notification_id) DO NOTHING
mapper.select: WITH candidates AS ( SELECT outbox_id FROM public.tb_push_outbox WHERE status = 'PENDING' OR (status = 'PROCESSING' AND lease_until <= CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) ORDER BY created_at, outbox_id FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED LIMIT #{limit, jdbcType=INTEGER} ) UPDATE public.tb_push_outbox AS outbox SET status = 'PROCESSING', attempt_count = outbox.attempt_count + 1, lease_token = #{leaseToken, jdbcType=OTHER}, lease_until = #{leaseUntil, jdbcType=TIMESTAMP}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP FROM candidates WHERE outbox.outbox_id = candidates.outbox_id RETURNING outbox.outbox_id AS outboxId, outbox.notification_id AS notificationId, outbox.status, outbox.attempt_count AS attemptCount, outbox.lease_token AS leaseToken, outbox.lease_until AS leaseUntil, outbox.created_at AS createdAt, outbox.updated_at AS updatedAt, outbox.completed_at AS completedAt
mapper.update: UPDATE public.tb_push_outbox SET status = 'EXPANDED', lease_token = NULL, lease_until = NULL, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE outbox_id = #{id, jdbcType=BIGINT} AND status = 'PROCESSING' AND lease_token = #{leaseToken, jdbcType=OTHER} AND lease_until > CURRENT_TIMESTAMP

UPDATE public.tb_push_outbox SET status = 'NO_RECIPIENT', lease_token = NULL, lease_until = NULL, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, completed_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE outbox_id = #{id, jdbcType=BIGINT} AND status = 'PROCESSING' AND lease_token = #{leaseToken, jdbcType=OTHER} AND lease_until > CURRENT_TIMESTAMP

UPDATE public.tb_push_outbox AS outbox SET status = 'COMPLETED', updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, completed_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE outbox.outbox_id = #{id, jdbcType=BIGINT} AND outbox.status = 'EXPANDED' AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM public.tb_push_delivery AS delivery WHERE delivery.outbox_id = outbox.outbox_id AND delivery.status IN ('PENDING', 'PROCESSING', 'RETRY_WAIT') )

UPDATE public.tb_push_outbox SET status = 'FAILED', lease_token = NULL, lease_until = NULL, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, completed_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE outbox_id = #{id, jdbcType=BIGINT} AND status = 'PROCESSING' AND lease_token = #{leaseToken, jdbcType=OTHER} AND lease_until > CURRENT_TIMESTAMP

UPDATE public.tb_push_delivery AS delivery SET status = 'SUPPRESSED', lease_token = NULL, lease_until = NULL, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, completed_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP FROM public.tb_push_subscription AS subscription WHERE delivery.subscription_id = subscription.subscription_id AND delivery.outbox_id = #{outboxId, jdbcType=BIGINT} AND subscription.status = 'INACTIVE' AND ( delivery.status IN ('PENDING', 'RETRY_WAIT') OR ( delivery.status = 'PROCESSING' AND delivery.lease_until <= CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ) )
mapper.select: WITH candidates AS ( SELECT delivery.delivery_id FROM public.tb_push_delivery AS delivery INNER JOIN public.tb_push_subscription AS subscription ON subscription.subscription_id = delivery.subscription_id AND subscription.status = 'ACTIVE' WHERE delivery.status = 'PENDING' OR ( delivery.status = 'RETRY_WAIT' AND delivery.next_attempt_at <= CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ) OR ( delivery.status = 'PROCESSING' AND delivery.lease_until <= CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ) ORDER BY COALESCE(delivery.next_attempt_at, delivery.created_at), delivery.delivery_id FOR UPDATE OF delivery SKIP LOCKED LIMIT #{limit, jdbcType=INTEGER} ) UPDATE public.tb_push_delivery AS delivery SET status = 'PROCESSING', attempt_count = delivery.attempt_count + 1, lease_token = #{leaseToken, jdbcType=OTHER}, lease_until = #{leaseUntil, jdbcType=TIMESTAMP}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP FROM candidates WHERE delivery.delivery_id = candidates.delivery_id RETURNING delivery.delivery_id AS deliveryId, delivery.outbox_id AS outboxId, delivery.subscription_id AS subscriptionId, delivery.status, delivery.attempt_count AS attemptCount, delivery.next_attempt_at AS nextAttemptAt, delivery.lease_token AS leaseToken, delivery.lease_until AS leaseUntil, delivery.last_error_code AS lastErrorCode, delivery.created_at AS createdAt, delivery.updated_at AS updatedAt, delivery.completed_at AS completedAt
mapper.update: UPDATE public.tb_push_delivery SET status = 'SENT', lease_token = NULL, lease_until = NULL, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, completed_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE delivery_id = #{id, jdbcType=BIGINT} AND status = 'PROCESSING' AND lease_token = #{leaseToken, jdbcType=OTHER} AND lease_until > CURRENT_TIMESTAMP

UPDATE public.tb_push_delivery SET status = 'RETRY_WAIT', next_attempt_at = #{nextAttemptAt, jdbcType=TIMESTAMP}, last_error_code = #{errorCode, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, lease_token = NULL, lease_until = NULL, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE delivery_id = #{id, jdbcType=BIGINT} AND status = 'PROCESSING' AND lease_token = #{leaseToken, jdbcType=OTHER} AND lease_until > CURRENT_TIMESTAMP

UPDATE public.tb_push_delivery SET status = 'PERMANENT_FAILURE', lease_token = NULL, lease_until = NULL, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, completed_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE delivery_id = #{id, jdbcType=BIGINT} AND status = 'PROCESSING' AND lease_token = #{leaseToken, jdbcType=OTHER} AND lease_until > CURRENT_TIMESTAMP

UPDATE public.tb_push_delivery SET status = 'EXHAUSTED', lease_token = NULL, lease_until = NULL, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, completed_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE delivery_id = #{id, jdbcType=BIGINT} AND status = 'PROCESSING' AND lease_token = #{leaseToken, jdbcType=OTHER} AND lease_until > CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
